meta.path_hash_format: CRC32 (zlib/IEEE) of the transform path string relative to the Animator root node (the GO whose child is pelvicJNT, i.e. unit.<name>/Scaler)
meta.skeleton_convention: unit.<charname>/Scaler/pelvicJNT/spine1JNT/... (Maya-style *JNT names); shared clips use paths starting at pelvicJNT
